parsed.post: Latest experiment (val_bpb 0.834696) was slightly worse than d2f41b5 (0.828335). Reverting to d2f41b5. Next, I'll try reducing the learning rate further; since we increased depth and aspect ratio, a lower LR might help converge better within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to improve stability and regularization for the larger capacity model.
